style_prompt: Standalone ordinary otherworld fantasy game item icon; clean Japanese anime 2D illustration using large graphic color blocks, stable crisp linework, grouped shadows, and a few restrained highlights; natural handmade materials such as glass, cork, brass, cloth, leather, wood, baked bread, raw boneless meat, cooked steak, stone and plant matter as appropriate; clear readable silhouette at gameplay size; no technology, sci-fi, cyberpunk, Y2K, retro-futurist or modern industrial design; genuine transparent alpha background, one object only, no text, no logo, no watermark, no grid.

processing.note: Crop near-transparent generation haze, fit the visible subject inside the target unrotated grid footprint, preserve alpha.

Preserve the iron sword's cool silver-blue steel blade, modest golden brass crossguard, small tasteful gold central blade fittings, round brass pommel and dark brown leather grip. Keep the fuller blade shape and sober materials; no sheath. ONLY one unsheathed perfectly straight upright iron longsword.
